crossRefs.note: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

translations.web: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”
translations.bsb: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies.”
translations.kjv: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
